cases.question: Fictional ledger only, no saving: Oren’s bag plus body weighed 9.1 kg. An amendment replaces that total with 8.8 kg. The empty bag was 600 g both times. What corrected body mass should be used? Answer in grams only.
cases.expected: 8200 g; corrected total minus bag, no averaging.

cases.question: Fictional records: Tuesday says Sol scratched the right ear. Wednesday retracts Tuesday as entered for the wrong animal, without naming the correct animal. Which animal can the scratching now be confidently assigned to?
cases.expected: Cannot confidently assign; do not retain Sol or invent replacement.

cases.question: Fictional archive: a July 9 entry says Rhea started refusing lunch two days earlier. It was uploaded July 12. On July 10, could a reader of the uploaded archive know this? Distinguish event, note, and upload dates.
cases.expected: Event July7, noteJuly9, uploadJuly12; not availableJuly10 fromarchive.

cases.question: Fictional activity notes: Rio walked 8 minutes Monday and 14 minutes Friday, with no other entries. Can we say walking time increased a little every day that week?
cases.expected: No daily trend established between endpoints.

cases.question: Fictional study: one household changed food, feeding time, and bowl location together. Appetite improved afterward. Which individual change has been proven responsible?
cases.expected: None isolated; concurrent changes and observational association do not provecause.

cases.question: Fictional measurements: a tank began at 2.0 L, received exactly 400 mL, and ended at 1.7 L. Total outflow is knowable, but drinking and spilling were not separated. Give total outflow and whether drinking alone is knowable.
Fictional body weights: Uma 3.6 kg, Vito 4200 g. Their empty transport box is 1.1 kg. Give the combined body weight and the loaded box weight in kg, keeping the two quantities distinct.
Fictional log: a walk changed from 20 to 15 minutes. State the percent change using the earlier walk as the baseline; do not infer a health change.
Fictional report: Nia’s neighbor told Nia that the neighbor’s son saw cat Wren hide. Identify the observer and the person who relayed the report to Nia, separately.
Fictional scene: two rabbits, Ember and Gale, share a room. An unsigned note says "my rabbit skipped breakfast." No other ownership information exists. Does that identify Ember or Gale?
Fictional values: Aloe weighs 1.25 kg; no age was supplied. Return JSON only with weight_g as a number and age_years as null.
cases.expected: ValidJSON weight_g1250 age_yearsnull no extra prose.
